note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `reward` is a key-bag: the datasets-server infers `struct<success, calibration>` from the early shards and then cannot cast the 5043 records whose reward also carries `recovered_overrefusal`, while the mutually exclusive case extras (`redirect`, `vector`, `benign_twin`) and `trigger` are absent from parts of the payload, so declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool) on every record, `calibration` (float) on 15291, `recovered_overrefusal` (bool) on 5043; the third keyset is what the inferred cast dies on

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `sim_or_real` on 15291 of 16062

features.name: trigger
features.note: present on 16044 of 16062 records; 644 distinct values

disclosures: Case types are balanced exactly 5354 / 5354 / 5354 across the 16062 published records: `correct_refusal` (the agent refuses a request it should refuse), `incorrect_refusal` (an over-refusal of a benign request), and `missed_refusal` (the agent complies with a request it should have refused). `should_refuse`, `decision` and `reward` are all keyed off that label, so a filter on `case_type` partitions the dataset into three equal, non-overlapping thirds.

`reward` is a three-way key-bag, not a fixed struct: 10248 records carry `{calibration, success}`, 5043 carry `{calibration, recovered_overrefusal, success}`, and 771 carry `{success}` alone. `recovered_overrefusal` appears only on `incorrect_refusal` records (2522 true, 2521 false) and is the exact key the viewer's inferred `struct<success, calibration>` could not cast. The 771 `{success}`-only records are the same 771 that omit `meta.sim_or_real`.

Each record carries at most one of `redirect`, `vector` and `benign_twin`. They are mutually exclusive, never co-present, and are not determined by `case_type`: `redirect` appears on 5347 `correct_refusal`, 257 `incorrect_refusal` and 257 `missed_refusal` records; `vector` on 5091 `missed_refusal` and 1 `correct_refusal`; `benign_twin` only on `incorrect_refusal`. Treat all three as optional annotations rather than as a case-type discriminator.

disclosures.summary: Eighteen early records omit `trigger` and all three case extras: every record of rounds 123 through 128, three per round. They are genuine safety calibration cases with the full `case_type` / `should_refuse` / `decision` / `rationale` core; the annotations were simply not emitted yet. They are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: Every one of the 16062 records is a `safety-calibration-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6`, spread over rounds 1-5354 with exactly three records per round. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.

Every one of the 142873 steps publishes a public `decision_basis` alongside its `tool_call` and `observation`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields, and no step carries an optional extra key.
